name: Rival — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Rival from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Rival (Story)" but are not part of the Rival entry, which is unchanged.

Special: Thwarting you becomes an all-consuming goal for your rival. Your rival gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks, saving throws, and skill checks against you. Your rival attempts to steal or undermine accomplishments which you strive to achieve.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)
You and your rival wish to earn entry into the a great tournament, and you must ensure you are victorious.
You and an old friend vie for the sole opening at one of the grand houses, but only one of you will be accepted.
You and a relative with equally distant descent both strive to be the first to unseat the King and claim rulership.
You and a fellow explorer each hope to be the first to reveal a lost dwarven citadel.
